summary: GrowHub Ltd (Nasdaq: TGHL) filed a Form 6-K reporting a binding summary term sheet with EnChem America, Inc. for a proposed merger. Under the terms, EnChem will merge into a newly formed, wholly-owned subsidiary of GrowHub and become the surviving entity. At closing, EnChem will receive 85% of GrowHub's fully diluted equity, while pre-closing GrowHub holders retain 15%. No price per share, premium, or consideration type is stated. The deal requires GrowHub stockholder approval under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(a) and customary closing conditions. The non-binding term sheet will become binding upon formal execution. Watch for definitive merger agreement and stockholder vote.
